input_sequence.comment: The client joined, the ready gate ran and the match is live on the host.
A simulant has carried the briefcase for 1 s.
The carrier dies through chrDamageByMisc and drops the briefcase (botinvDrop announces it).
The 150 s time limit ends the match; same at_ms as the kill so it runs after it.
Scripted clean exit 5 s (script time) after the host's results.
